description: Key verification values from the final manuscript. Compare regenerated results against these. Structural metrics are exact; UMAP-dependent metrics can vary slightly across package versions/platforms (see tolerance notes).
manuscript: Syed Sohail & Daqing Chen (2026), Machine-learning-derived chemical signatures for network-scale river monitoring: A case study of England's routine water-quality archive

structural.note: All 20 (n_min x n_sites_min) support-threshold combinations yield the identical 12-feature / 8,857-site panel.

overlap_at_5.tolerance: exact on the provided processed matrices

wfd_typology_agreement_available.note: Macro-average of (matches / peers-with-known-typology); denominator = 96 focal sites with a WFD typology.

reproduced_live_during_packaging.note: Values below were regenerated by this package's own scripts on the provided processed matrices during assembly.
